additional_info.subject: 0472223 - ID0472223-DC/Si-D/BE- [MP / S6 170003805] Firmware Update CRM:00314000255
additional_info.body:
Dear Bart,
I am following up our conversation via MS Teams in regards of this ticket
ID0472223.
The ticket has been opened by End Customer Sparki, asking to update 78 chargers to the latest FW
v8.1.4.
Few considerations have to be made:
Customer did not provide a list of charger IDs, but I can see form your note that you have the list. Could you please attach it to the ticket?
All chargers seem to be
out of warranty
.
Customer asked to perform the updates overnight. At the moment, from TS side we do not provide support overnight unless a particular SLA is in place. You can refer to Afonso Sousa or Rui Teodoso for further information.
I checked on SCB, and your profile has L2 access rights. According to our internal documentation, you should be able to activate the updates yourself. If this is not the case, please let us know so we will inform Serviceability to revise the internal documentation.
Given the above points, from HQ side we can support you only if a PO is in place, being all the chargers out of warranty,
as per established process.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
I moving the case
0472223
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-NL SI E Queue
.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-NL SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
Important notice: This e-mail and any attachment thereof contain corporate proprietary information. If you have received it by mistake, please notify us immediately by reply e-mail and delete this e-mail and its attachments from your system.
Thank you.
